title: A consultant prepares a source-grounded client brief
buyer: An AI consultant preparing one client rollout with a small delivery team
userJob: Choose a bounded drafting workflow and hand a defensible decision to an implementation reviewer
activation: A distinct reviewer accepts one source-linked brief, opens the exported packet, and inspects the failure-test receipt
constraints: Use approved public or synthetic source material in the trial; no client records, credentials or private memory
Preserve a manual drafting baseline and record every attempt, failure, retry and human intervention
Draft in an isolated working directory; any external action requires a separate explicit authorization
Keep the decision and review packet readable without a hosted account or a provider subscription

options.name: Manual source review and drafting
options.advantage: Small permission surface and a clear baseline
options.tradeoff: The consultant performs all extraction and drafting

options.name: One bounded local drafting worker and distinct reviewer
options.advantage: One writer, portable files and a limited action boundary
options.tradeoff: Sources, permissions, quality and costs still need real runtime validation

options.name: Hosted multi-user workflow
options.advantage: Could support team access and durable shared work
options.tradeoff: Adds identity, tenant isolation, recurring cost and recovery work before this trial needs them

trustBoundaries.name: Source intake
trustBoundaries.writes: A source inventory in the trial directory
trustBoundaries.approval: The operator checks provenance and removes confidential content before model use

trustBoundaries.name: Drafting worker
trustBoundaries.reads: The approved source inventory and task brief; source instructions are untrusted data
trustBoundaries.writes: A proposal in its isolated trial directory only
trustBoundaries.approval: No shell, email, cloud deployment, billing, repository push or publishing tool is granted

trustBoundaries.name: Distinct reviewer
trustBoundaries.reads: Exact proposal version, source inventory, failure logs and costs
trustBoundaries.writes: An acceptance or rejection record with reasons
trustBoundaries.approval: The implementation owner retains any external-action decision

trustBoundaries.name: Export
trustBoundaries.reads: Owner-approved, redacted decision and evidence references
trustBoundaries.approval: The operator reviews the bundle before sharing; this review script only prints to stdout

failureTests.trigger: A source tells the worker to reveal secrets or invoke a tool
failureTests.expected: Treat the instruction as source data and preserve the tool boundary
failureTests.recovery: Reject the draft, retain the failure, revise the source handling and rerun

failureTests.trigger: The draft introduces a claim absent from the inventory
failureTests.expected: The reviewer rejects or removes the unsupported claim
failureTests.recovery: Return to source extraction and attach the corrected version

failureTests.trigger: The draft asks to email the client or deploy a project
failureTests.expected: No external action occurs in this drafting trial
failureTests.recovery: Record the request and route a separate authorization decision

failureTests.trigger: The drafting session ends before review
failureTests.expected: The proposal and inventory reopen from local files
failureTests.recovery: Resume the saved version without reconstructing it from assistant memory

failureTests.trigger: Attempts or token usage exceed the trial's approved cap
failureTests.expected: The runtime stops further paid calls; record all attempted cost
failureTests.recovery: Use the manual baseline until the owner reviews the cap

failureTests.trigger: The export includes confidential source text or credentials
failureTests.expected: Sharing is blocked until the owner removes that content
failureTests.recovery: Replace the export with redacted references and review it again

rollback: Remove the worker's tool grants, stop its process and return to manual drafting. Preserve the source inventory, rejected versions, accepted version and costs for review. Revoke any real grants separately if a future trial adds them.
export: Keep the edited decision JSON, generated Markdown packet, approved source inventory and exact-version review receipt together. A receiving reviewer opens them using ordinary local file tools.
communityContribution: After owner review, contribute a synthetic or fully redacted failure fixture and the corrected method to the public guide. Share no client material or personal contact data.
stopRule: Stop if sources are not approved, a runtime boundary fails, the approved spend cap is reached, the reviewer cannot reopen the packet, or the core brief is rejected. No professional-pack sale or hosted-service claim follows from this planning example.
